description: This file defines API routes for managing products in an e-commerce backend, including CRUD operations, search, filtering, and image upload handling.

methods.name: GET /item/:slug
methods.description: Fetches a product by its slug if active and has a valid brand.

methods.name: GET /list/search/:name
methods.description: Searches for products by name with regex matching.

methods.name: GET /list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of products with advanced filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: GET /list/select
methods.description: Returns a list of product names for selection purposes.

methods.name: POST /add
methods.description: Adds a new product, including image upload and validation.

methods.name: GET /
methods.description: Retrieves all products, filtered by merchant if applicable.

methods.name: GET /:id
methods.description: Fetches a specific product by ID, considering merchant ownership.

methods.name: PUT /:id
methods.description: Updates product details, ensuring SKU and slug uniqueness.

methods.name: PUT /:id/active
methods.description: Updates the active status of a product.
